title: Require an explicit Agent scope for every Skill agent loop
goal: Prevent the public SkillAgentOrchestrator entry point from selecting and executing any installed Skill when no Agent manifest supplies an allowlist.
context: After M8 public entry points were scoped, SkillAgentOrchestrator still exposes run(goalStatement:inputJSON:policy:) that delegates with agent:nil, making all installed Skills eligible. This contradicts fail-closed Agent scope at the orchestration boundary. CI exposed one existing registry test that still calls the now-forbidden unscoped overload; migrate that test to assert the fail-closed contract.
forbidden_changes: Do not widen Agent manifests or silently synthesize a default allowlist.
Do not bypass runtime policy, execute capability checks, approval, cancellation, or output verification.
Do not modify UI, provider/GGUF, or unrelated runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The public orchestrator overload without an Agent fails closed with a typed error.
The overload accepting AgentManifest remains the only successful orchestration path.
Regression test proves unscoped execution is rejected before Skill selection or executor invocation.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA checks on the final PR head.
recovery: If source compatibility tests reveal a legitimate unscoped caller, migrate that caller to an explicit AgentManifest; do not restore implicit all-Skill selection.
